Released on 2026-11-04.

item.title: v0.9.7
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.7

Released on 2026-11-03.

Studio playback no longer freezes WebGL scenes when motion blur is on. Preview playback now lands on the same frame as a scrub or an export when a set cuts into a running tween. Your CLI login now takes priority over an API key left in your shell.

Features

  • Lint: overlapping_gsap_tweens now also flags a set that fires while a tween on the same element and property is still running, a pattern that plays differently from how it scrubs and exports (5e30bbdbe, #7059).
  • Preview: A video the browser cannot play, such as HEVC without a decoder or ProRes, shows its own frame at the playhead instead of black while its playable copy is made. Copy progress is now reported at Full quality too (eb3562966, #6589).

Fixes

  • Studio: With motion blur on, a scene that draws to a WebGL canvas no longer freezes during preview playback. Motion blur now falls back for those scenes, as it already did in renders (112ba5330, #7060).
  • Core: Preview playback now lands on the same frame as a scrub or an export when a set fires inside a running tween on the same property. Before, a word hidden just before its pop-in ended could stay on screen while playing (0f85af7c7, #7061).
  • CLI: hyperframes cloud render no longer offers --page-motion-blur, because the hosted render API rejected requests that used it. Turn motion blur on in the composition with data-motion-blur="on". Local hyperframes render --page-motion-blur is unchanged (dffc640e8, #7062).
  • CLI: A session from hyperframes auth login now takes priority over HEYGEN_API_KEY and HYPERFRAMES_API_KEY, so a key left in your shell no longer replaces the account you signed in with. The key still wins when HEYGEN_API_URL or HEYGEN_API_BASE points at another host, or when the login cannot refresh (d03bdeae9, #7051).
  • Studio Server: Two exports of the same project started within one second now get their own jobs and output files. Before, the second export replaced the first (92943d99f, #7053).
  • CLI: hyperframes snapshot no longer crashes Chrome on a project with many clips cut from one 4K video. Like render, it now stops Chrome from decoding local videos it already replaces with extracted frames (81b93cf05, #6949).
  • CLI: The latestVersion value in --json output is never older than the CLI you are running, even right after an upgrade (8a6636efe, #7049).
  • CLI: hyperframes auth login --device now works without a terminal, such as in a coding agent's shell or an SSH command. It still refuses to run in CI (de2603e63, #7045).

Docs & Examples

  • Skills: The reverse skill asks once for a credit top-up that covers the whole run when several steps run out at the same time, and builds its project with init --video (05ddddbbf, #7048).
  • Changelog: Added the weekly update for October 26 to November 2, 2026 (6feb4bec7, #7032).
  • Changelog: The v0.9.6 release notes now list four changes they had missed (4ef8c1de5, #7040).

Internal

  • Studio Server: Raised the package size budget to fit the new preview features (b22af8f25, #7044).

Full changelog

Released on 2026-11-02.

Audio stems can now be read through your HeyGen account, with no Gemini key. The player shows the blurred frame and the mark while assets load.   • Core: The preview recovers its WebGL scenes and effects after a lost context (e8ffaa410f, #7028).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.0

Released on 2026-11-02.

Distributed rendering on AWS Lambda and Google Cloud Run now runs only on Plan v2. This is a breaking release: the Plan v1 transport, the planProtocol option and the Plan v1 event and result types are removed. A preview video that runs short of data now holds instead of looping snippets.

Upgrading from 0.8

  • Upgrade the SDK and the deployment together. Redeploy your Lambda stack or Cloud Run service from 0.9.0 when you move your app to the 0.9.0 SDK.
  • Drop planProtocol from renderToLambda and renderToCloudRun calls. Leaving it out, or passing "v2", works as before. Passing "v1" now throws.
  • Old Plan v1 events are rejected. A handler or service on 0.9.0 answers a v1 payload with PLAN_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED before doing any render work.
  • Removed producer exports: plan, createPlanV2FromV1, publishPlanV2FromV1, readPlanProtocol, readPlanProtocolV1, PLAN_PROTOCOL_V1, CURRENT_PLAN_PROTOCOL, PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION, PLAN_HASH_SCHEMA, PLAN_ARTIFACT_LAYOUT, DISTRIBUTED_RENDER_CAPABILITIES and getDistributedRenderCapabilities, plus their types. Use planV2, planV2WithPublisher or publishPlanV2FromExecutionPlan instead.
  • PLAN_TOO_LARGE and PlanTooLargeError are removed from @hyperframes/producer/distributed. The plan-size cap only applied to Plan v1, and Plan v2 never raises it, so drop any checks for that error.
  • Removed adapter types: LambdaPlanProtocol, PlanV1LambdaResult, CloudRunPlanProtocol, PlanV1ResultBody, and PlanV1Event, RenderChunkV1Event and AssembleV1Event from both adapter packages.

Breaking Changes

  • Producer, AWS Lambda, Cloud Run: Remove the Plan v1 distributed transport (7f48a6894, #6970).

Fixes

  • Core: A preview video short of data holds the film instead of looping snippets (8519f2836, #6974).
  • CLI: Diff warns when yours runs at another frame rate (99223d993, #6976).
  • Core: A smaller preview copy nobody wants any more no longer swaps in (6bbda219b, #6973).
  • CLI: Diff stops counting a fast move as an extra cut (b1316e61d, #6978).

  • CLI: Capture watchdog tests use a fake output folder outside the temp dir (8142d6d59, #6828).

HyperFrames v0.8.216

Released on 2026-10-29.

This release carries every change from v0.8.215, which never reached npm. iPhone Safari keeps every take's sound, multi-worker renders land each frame in place, and encoding runs faster.

Features

  • Telemetry: Identify signed-in CLI users by their HyperFrames user id, and say signed-in usage is not anonymous (1c3fcf4d2, #6703).
  • Producer: Report which element set the film length (3ca1005a8, #6689).

Fixes

  • Player: iPhone Safari keeps every take's sound after the first seconds of an edit (48ba0e5b2, #6724).
  • AWS Lambda: The release ffmpeg build falls back to verified mirrors when a source host is down (f0665f718, #6728).
  • CLI: A failed render names its failure code for the Desktop app (ba8ffffa0, #6725).
  • CLI: A snapshot still shows what playback shows, whatever other times are asked for (cf1589242, #6720).
  • CLI: The lint summary points at hyperframes lint, not a flag only render takes (98a28cc4b, #6723).
  • Ci: Skills sync steps past the five hidden ClawHub versions blocking it (49e031230, #6713).
  • CLI: An unknown command like search says which command does that (bb4deb801, #6710).
  • CLI: Check says how many browser-playable copies are done while it makes them (2f8c4b1da, #6712).
  • Core: A multi-worker or chunked render lands every frame where an in-order render does (fa9acbd73, #6707).
  • CLI: Check says a lint error is why the browser pass was skipped (11312b359, #6709).
  • CLI: Capture names the network's proxy when it refuses the connection to the site (f0c5db6ea, #6706).
  • CLI: Check waits as long as the --timeout it was given before it counts as idle (6c1765933, #6705).
  • CLI: Audio windows read beats off the whole clip; beats snap to the signal and mark silence (4fa5f5451, #6692).
  • Producer: A BeginFrame capture that draws no first frame in 20 s switches to screenshot (a5496b188, #6701).
  • CLI: Media-treatment --capability preset finds the presets area (cfa653af4, #6700).
  • CLI: A Windows render no longer prints taskkill's already-exited message (ac449555f, #6698).
  • CLI: Snapshot reads https video in the Desktop app instead of failing at ffprobe (0620067eb, #6699).
  • CLI: A stopped model download resumes on the next run instead of starting over (81959201f, #6694).
  • CLI: Media-treatment finds an area by the name its overview prints (2c3d1e07f, #6675).
  • Engine: Downloads refuse hosts that resolve to private addresses (9830059bd, #6571).
  • CLI: Check no longer reports outline text as not painted (9f65efb19, #6693).
  • CLI: Beats --json answers with no track when the composition has no music (ec10aae54, #6690).
  • Core: Graded media honors object-position vertically instead of mirroring it (aa4a71fe4, #6691).
  • Studio: Audio keeps playing after a timeline move or trim in a static composition (9aa6346a7, #6428).
  • Engine: A render from an app that bundles the engine stamps the engine's version (cdc86117c, #6686).
  • Studio: An undo or redo counts as a preview change from its key, not from its reload (710314c15, #6683).
  • Producer: A capture that landed every frame is not failed for the work after its last frame (067cbf7ac, #6674).
  • CLI: Check no longer treats a transparent canvas as covering the frame (203a08dd7, #6681).

  • Studio: Keep the canvas outline off the scaled preview iframe (624c9becfde73, #6452).
  • CLI: A snapshot clip whose frame fails is named with ffmpeg's reason (7a0c75bb69925, #6564).
  • CLI: A nearer copy of another version no longer hides the host's pinned onnxruntime-node (5561640809154, #6563).

HyperFrames v0.8.194

Released on 2026-10-25.

Undo and restore in Studio keep the media they delete or replace, so a history step never loses a file. Motion blur no longer blacks out videos inside sub-compositions, and around 25 smaller fixes land across the CLI, core and lint.

Features

  • Studio: The blur panel turns on events with blur (19374955c7bc8, #6255).

Fixes

  • CLI: Scope explicit preview port discovery (e7169ae85b454, #6242).
  • Studio Server: Undo and restore keep the media they delete or replace (85fb19f1e822c, #6215).
  • Parsers: Keep each keyframe array on its own timing (5b752168c14a5, #6240).
  • Core: Scene shots keep their shell after leading comments (6e77d783c7c19, #6239).
  • Engine: Concat resolves relative paths without dropping clips (17332cf0df4d5, #6238).
  • Player: Keep Next available for the final slide's reveals (680f5d7465e63, #6233).
  • Sdk: Keep added elements when reopening saved overrides (31e6ed2aed959, #6231).
  • CLI: Emit valid JSON for filtered keyframes (6a917780f5903, #6228).
  • Lint: Accept GLSL script blocks without JavaScript syntax errors (f21c3e3e7e838, #6227).
  • Producer: Report unavailable frame checks in debug logs (0c3387b8beeb7, #6200).
  • Lint: Accept final font-family descriptors without semicolons (035a5c0ae1f9f, #6085).
  • Skills: Preserve Remotion easing mappings (6a2721c68a58c, #5561).
  • Producer: Keep runtime media speed in exports (066bc51831ebb, #5528).
  • Core: Prepare split-video offsets during preview preload (abcbde0b97ad9, #5356).
  • Render: Align container Chrome with the CLI (d6c20513d1f22, #5338).
  • Core: Resolve a relative data-start inside the clip's own composition (c2a6b15f6fcc1, #5336).
  • CLI: Report parent motion in template-wrapped keyframes (d36797a3b57d6, #5331).
  • CLI: Preserve ducking gain when music starts later (ad41745ab104a, #5318).
  • CLI: Preserve distinct font URLs during capture (f9d72a3f73753, #5312).
  • CLI: Include external video posters in project archives (e5e2d6f1df036, #5309).
  • CLI: Include captured raster formats in contact sheets (bb5e0f0bcf970, #5301).
  • CLI: Respect reference image orientation in grade comparisons (39364ee4fb520, #5288).
  • CLI: Reap only orphaned browsers HyperFrames launched (f180ffca64b4b, #6251).
  • Core: Motion blur no longer blacks out videos inside sub-compositions (b97de59c84a75, #6252).
  • Core: A video that starts a cut far behind the playhead catches up in steps, not at a flat 3% (e586922cd1e0c, #6198).
  • Studio: Allow a local GSAP dependency mirror (1c14fbb542897, #6247).
  • CLI: Allow disabling orphan browser cleanup (aefca2144c200, #6213).
  • Core: Name the selector when a scoped GSAP target matches nothing (e26d330887896, #5839).
  • Producer: A busy composition no longer stalls the render waiting on probe-page reads (9aadc0b9b99d9, #6241).
  • CLI: A Chrome download that stops sending is abandoned, retried, and releases the lock (fcec26ed5f35a, #6222).

Docs & Examples

  • Protect skill edits during contributor setup (0289d96ac78ab, #5346).
  • Studio App: Show the app working, three new pages, today's UI (7224812143d52, #6223).

Catalog

  • CLI: Refresh item manifests when bypassing registry cache (9a517560a827b, #5256).

Internal

  • CLI: Cover media URL duration probes (ecd7bf4184fe1, #5330).
  • Engine: Retry the alpha probe test's temp-dir cleanup when Windows holds a file (ab57d0ee14468, #6234).

Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.8.193...v0.8.194
